rounds.explain: Matshelo ndi duvha ḽi ḓaho; mulovha ndi duvha ḽo fhiraho.

rounds.sentence: Bola ḽi tsini na nna, ḽi kha ____.
rounds.explain: Hafha ndi tsini na ane a amba; henefho ndi kule nyana.

rounds.sentence: Muthu ane nda mu sumbedza kule ndi ____.
rounds.explain: Uyu ndi wa tsini; uyo ndi wa kule.
Nwana ndi muthihi; vhana ndi vhanzhi.
Muthu ndi muthihi; vhathu ndi vhanzhi.

rounds.sentence: Kha mudini uyu hu na ____ zwivhili.
rounds.explain: Tshikolo ndi tshithihi; zwikolo ndi zwinzhi.
Zwino ndi nga tshino tshifhinga; kale ndi tshifhinga tsho fhiraho.
Matsheloni ndi nga u bva ha ḓuvha; masiari ndi nga vhukati ha ḓuvha.
Nṱha ndi ngei nṱhesa; fhasi ndi fhasi.
Ngomu ndi nga nḓani; nnḓa ndi si ngomu.

rounds.sentence: Nnḓu ya makhadzi i ho ____ na hafha.
rounds.explain: Kule ndi si tsini; tsini ndi vhukufhi.

rounds.sentence: Muthu ane a khou tevhela goloi u kha ____ hayo.
rounds.explain: Phanḓa ndi u ranga; murahu ndi u tevhela.

rounds.sentence: Musi u na dora, u tea u ____ maḓi.
rounds.explain: Nwa ndi ya maḓi; ḽa ndi ya zwiḽiwa.

rounds.sentence: Musi mudededzi a tshi dzhena, vhana vha tea u ____.
rounds.explain: Ima ndi u bvelela nga milenzhe; dzula ndi u dzula fhasi.

rounds.sentence: Musidzana u bva hayani a tshi ya tshikoloni; u khou ____.
rounds.explain: Da ndi u ḓa hafha; ya ndi u bva wa ṱuwa.

kids.explain: Vula zwi ita uri hu dzhene muya; vala zwi tswala.
Eḓela ndi u awela; vuwa ndi u bva vhulaloni.
Sea ndi musi u takala; lila ndi musi mbilu i tshi vhavha.
Gidima ndi nga luvhilo; tshimbila ndi nga u ongolowa.

kids.sentence: Mmbwa ya Vho-Rammbuda a i ntswu, i ____.
kids.explain: Ntswu ndi muvhala wo swifhalaho; tshena ndi muvhala wo penyaho.

kids.sentence: Ṅwana wa miṅwaha mivhili u kha ḓi vha ____.
kids.explain: Khulwane ndi kulu; ṱhukhu ndi ṱuku.
Nthihi ndi ḽithihi; nnzhi ndi zwinzhi.
Mutukana ndi muṱhannga muṱuku; musidzana ndi ṅwananyana.

kids.sentence: Phoofholo ine ya riṋea mafhi manzhi ndi ____.
kids.explain: Kholomo iṋea mafhi manzhi; mbudzi ndi nnyana u fhira yone.
Tshanḓa tshi fara; mulenzhe u tshimbila.
